svg.title: noctcore/harness. Hold a repo to its own rules.
svg.desc: Checks that run in any CI, with no server and no account. A run where a lockfile rule and a pinned actionlint pass, a secret-no-install rule fails and a pinned zizmor is blocked. Zero runtime dependencies, no network call at run time.

g.aria-label: Hold a repo to its own rules.
Checks that run in any CI, with no server and no account.
a job reads NPM_TOKEN and runs npm ci
no network call at run time
Node 22, tested on Linux and Windows
